en.summary: Revenue grew 18.8% YoY as cloud expanded. GAAP earnings growth differs from growth excluding OpenAI investment effects. Cash capital spending reduced free cash flow 27.39% YoY. Segment comparisons use current recast definitions.
findings: Management reported $45.2B of investment capital expenditure and separately disclosed $7.4B of finance leases. Recognition and payment timing differ from cash purchases in the cash-flow statement. Next-quarter capital expenditure is expected to exceed $50B.
Calculated GAAP gross margin was 67.79%, down 1.25 percentage points YoY and up 0.6 points QoQ. Operating income was $45.915B, up 20.95% YoY.
GAAP EPS was $4.92, up 32.26% YoY. Company-adjusted EPS excluding OpenAI investment effects was $4.89, up 18.4%. Investment gains and the comparison base affect the two growth rates differently.

Revenue was $92.279B, up 18.8% YoY. Microsoft Cloud revenue was $63.9B, a cross-product aggregate that overlaps segments. Azure grew 48% in reported currency; this growth rate is not absolute Azure revenue.
Operating cash flow was $58B, up 28.73% YoY. Cash property and equipment purchases were $39.367B, leaving calculated free cash flow of $18.633B, down 27.39% YoY.
Operating cash flow was 158.34% of GAAP net income. Strong cash receipts can coexist with lower free cash flow after infrastructure investment.
Management expects FY2027 Q2 revenue of $96B–$97.1B. This is an outlook, rather than realized revenue or a comparison with a preserved consensus estimate.

limitations: Uses the official release and available official call transcript; the formal quarterly filing was not collected.
Microsoft Cloud overlaps product and segment categories. Azure growth does not disclose absolute revenue.
Segment definitions changed; YoY comparisons use current recast values and no old-definition QoQ series is constructed.
Calculated free cash flow subtracts cash property and equipment purchases. Investment capital expenditure and finance leases have different recognition and payment timing.
No pre-release consensus snapshot was preserved, so no beat/miss conclusion is made.
